description:
One decision: its text, its citations, its structural parts.

Text is windowed, never dumped whole. `text_window` says what came back and how
to get the rest. Citations cover that window only, with `*_outside_window`
counting the rest; repeats of one case roll up into `occurrences`.

Citations carry what was written and what it resolved to, so an unresolved one
stays visible. Join on `resolved_cause_num`, not the written number.

`case_citations` are what this decision cites. Text near a citation is this
court's reasoning, not the cited court's.

include_html.description: Also return canonical HTML (tables, emphasis, superscripts the text flattens). Always whole: the window cuts text, which offsets index.

max_chars.description: Cap on returned text characters; text_window.next_offset continues.

section.description: Parts to return text for: preamble, reasoning (what the court found), operative (what it ordered). Omit for all.

name: ua_edrsr__get_document
title: Get Court Decision (EDRSR)
